from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, status, Query, Body
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, validator
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
import sqlite3
import os
from datetime import datetime

app = FastAPI()

# Database configuration
DB_FILE = "tasks.db"

def get_db_connection():
    """Create database connection."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def init_db():
    """Initialize database and create table if not exists."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0,
            priority TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    ''')
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

# Pydantic models for validation
class TaskCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: Optional[str] = None
    priority: Optional[str] = "medium"
    
    @validator('title', mode='before')
    def validate_title(cls, v: str):
        if not v or v.strip() == "":
            raise ValueError("Title must be non-empty")
        return v.strip()
    
    @validator('priority', mode='before')
    def validate_priority(cls, v: str):
        if v not in ["low", "medium", "high"]:
            raise ValueError("Priority must be one of 'low', 'medium', 'high'")
        return v

class TaskResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    description: Optional[str]
    completed: bool
    priority: str
    created_at: str

class TaskUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = None
    completed: Optional[bool] = None
    priority: Optional[str] = None
    
    @validator('title', mode='after')
    def validate_title_after(cls, v: str):
        if not v or v.strip() == "":
            raise ValueError("Title must be non-empty")
        return v.strip()

@app.on_event("startup")
def startup_event():
    init_db()

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Task Tracker API is running"}

@app.post("/tasks", status_code=201)
def create_task(task: TaskCreate):
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, completed, priority) 
        VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?)
    ''', (task.title, task.description, task.priority))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    # Fetch the created task to return full details
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = (SELECT LAST_INSERT ROWID)
    ''')
    task_row = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if not task_row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task creation failed")
    
    return TaskResponse(
        id=task_row["id"],
        title=task_row["title"],
        description=task_row["description"],
        completed=task_row["completed"],
        priority=task_row["priority"],
        created_at=task_row["created_at"]
    )

@app.get("/tasks")
def get_tasks(
    completed: Optional[bool] = None,
    priority: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, le=100),
    page_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100)
):
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    sql = "SELECT id, title, description, completed, priority, created_at FROM tasks ORDER BY id ASC"
    
    params = []
    
    if completed is not None:
        sql += " WHERE completed = ?"
        params.append(completed)
    
    if priority is not None:
        sql += " AND priority = ?"
        params.append(priority)
    
    cursor.execute(sql + " LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (page_size, (page - 1) * page_size))
    tasks = cursor.fetchall()
    
    total = cursor.execute(sql).rowcount
    
    return {
        "items": [
            TaskResponse(
                id=t["id"],
                title=t["title"],
                description=t["description"],
                completed=t["completed"],
                priority=t["priority"],
                created_at=t["created_at"]
            )
            for t in tasks
        ],
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "page_size": page_size
    }
    
    conn.close()

@app.get("/tasks/{task_id}")
def get_task(task_id: int):
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,))
    task_row = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if not task_row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task not found")
    
    return TaskResponse(
        id=task_row["id"],
        title=task_row["title"],
        description=task_row["description"],
        completed=task_row["completed"],
        priority=task_row["priority"],
        created_at=task_row["created_at"]
    )

@app.put("/tasks/{task_id}")
def update_task(task_id: int, task: TaskUpdate):
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    updates = []
    params = []
    
    if task.title is not None:
        updates.append("title = ?")
        params.append(task.title)
    
    if task.description is not None:
        updates.append("description = ?")
        params.append(task.description)
    
    if task.completed is not None:
        updates.append("completed = ?")
        params.append(task.completed)
    
    if task.priority is not None:
        if task.priority not in ["low", "medium", "high"]:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid priority")
        updates.append("priority = ?")
        params.append(task.priority)
    
    if not updates:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="At least one field must be provided")
    
    sql = f"UPDATE tasks SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id = ?"
    params.append(task_id)
    
    cursor.execute(sql, params)
    conn.commit()
    
    # Fetch updated task
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,))
    task_row = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if not task_row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task not found")
    
    return TaskResponse(
        id=task_row["id"],
        title=task_row["title"],
        description=task_row["description"],
        completed=task_row["completed"],
        priority=task_row["priority"],
        created_at=task_row["created_at"]
    )

@app.delete("/tasks/{task_id}")
def delete_task(task_id: int):
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
